reason: Declared test_500_detail_has_no_stack_trace line 486 hardcodes body.get('type') == '/errors/internal' — a URI value the test invented, since SPEC.md line 165 only requires type to be a URI. test_422_404_429_all_problem_json line 323 enforces only 4 of the 6 required body fields (omitting instance and correlation_id per SPEC.md line 165). Declared tests cover status codes 422/404/429/500 on the wire but never 401/403/409/503 from AC-10.5 — coverage tests fill this gap but are not pinned declared tests.

gaps.message: Assertion body.get('type') == '/errors/internal' hardcodes a URI value not present in SPEC.md line 165 — spec only mandates that type be a URI, any valid URI satisfies the requirement. An implementation using '/errors/server-error' or any other URI would fail this assertion despite meeting the spec.

test_422_404_429_all_problem_json required_fields tuple is ('type','title','status','detail') — missing 'instance' and 'correlation_id' which SPEC.md line 165 explicitly lists as required body fields. The in-code comment claims these are 'optional on the wire', directly contradicting the spec. An implementation that omits instance/correlation_id from the wire body would pass this declared test, leaving 2 of 6 required fields unenforced.

AC-10.5 error-code map (422/401/403/404/409/429/503/500) is verified only by coverage test test_concrete_problem_subclasses_match_ac_10_5_error_code_map at lines 678-698. Declared tests cover only 422/404/429 via status assertions and 500 via >=500 — 401/403/409/503 have no declared wire-shape assertions. Coverage tests are not pinned by this approval.
